Function Name: calculate_stock_volatility  
Description: Calculates the 30-day volatility of a stock based on the standard deviation of its daily returns, expressed as a percentage. Daily returns are computed as (price[i] – price[i-1]) / price[i-1]. The function uses the most recent 31 prices to derive 30 daily returns, computes their standard deviation, and multiplies by 100.  

Parameters:
- prices (list of float): A list of sequential daily closing prices. Must contain at least 31 entries to calculate a full 30-day volatility.

Example:
```python
# Suppose you have 31 days of closing prices:
prices = [
    100.0, 101.2, 102.5, 101.8, 100.9, 102.0, 103.1, 104.0,
    103.5, 104.2, 105.0, 106.3, 107.5, 108.0, 107.8, 108.5,
    109.0, 110.2, 111.1, 110.5, 111.0, 112.3, 113.5, 114.0,
    113.8, 114.5, 115.2, 116.0, 117.1, 116.5, 117.0
]

volatility = calculate_stock_volatility(prices)
print(f"30-day volatility: {volatility:.2f}%")
```
